approved_command_preview: Issue #380 corrected evidence pass: generate #382 baseline inventory from merge commit 44fc4a4, compare normalized generated inventory/contracts against current main, handle no-index diffs safely, run workflow maintenance audits, and write artifact summaries before pass/fail. No source edits or workflow dispatches.
command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$repo = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('DCOIR_REPO_ROOT','Machine')
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($repo)) { $repo = (Get-Location).Path }
Set-Location $repo
$outRoot = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('DCOIR_DOWNLOADS_DIR','Machine')
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($outRoot)) { $outRoot = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'dcoir_issue380' }
$out = Join-Path $outRoot 'issue380-workflow-regression-002'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $out | Out-Null
$baseline = '44fc4a4dc5f8eef78536979decb60377a214e6c2'
$requestHead = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
$current = $requestHead
try {
  $parent = (git rev-parse "$requestHead^" ).Trim()
  $changed = @(git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r $requestHead)
  if (($changed.Count -eq 1) -and ($changed[0] -like '.github/chatgpt_staging/exec_requests/*.json')) { $current = $parent }
} catch { }
$workRoot = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'dcoir_issue380_exec002_work'
$baselineWorktree = Join-Path $workRoot 'baseline-44fc4a4'
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue $baselineWorktree
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $workRoot | Out-Null
$results = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[object]
$errors = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string]
$failed = $false
function Run-Step([string]$Name, [string]$CommandLine, [string]$WorkingDirectory = $repo, [bool]$Optional = $false) {
  $log = Join-Path $out "$Name.log"
  "PS> cd $WorkingDirectory" | Out-File -FilePath $log -Encoding utf8
  "PS> $CommandLine" | Out-File -FilePath $log -Encoding utf8 -Append
  if (-not (Test-Path $WorkingDirectory)) {
    "Working directory does not exist: $WorkingDirectory" | Out-File -FilePath $log -Encoding utf8 -Append
    $code = 127
  } else {
    Push-Location $WorkingDirectory
    cmd /d /c $CommandLine >> $log 2>&1
    $code = $LASTEXITCODE
    Pop-Location
  }
  $null = $results.Add([ordered]@{ name = $Name; exit_code = $code; optional = $Optional; log = (Split-Path -Leaf $log) })
  if (($code -ne 0) -and (-not $Optional)) { $script:failed = $true }
  return $code
}
function Normalize-RelocationText([string]$Text) {
  $pairs = @(
    @('.github/scripts/chatgpt_apply_in','tools/chatgpt_apply_in'),
    @('.github/scripts/chatgpt_stage_out','tools/chatgpt_stage_out'),
    @('.github/dcoir_review/scripts','scripts'),
    @('.github/dcoir_review/prompts','prompts'),
    @('.github/dcoir_review/schemas','schemas'),
    @('.github/chatgpt_staging','chatgpt_staging'),
    @('.github/github_actions','project_sources/github_actions'),
    @('.github/operator_tools','operator_tools'),
    @('.github/ops','ops')
  )
  $value = $Text -replace "`r`n", "`n"
  foreach ($pair in $pairs) { $value = $value.Replace($pair[0], $pair[1]) }
  return $value.Trim()
}
function Read-TextFile([string]$Path, [string]$Label) {
  if (-not (Test-Path $Path)) {
    $script:failed = $true
    $null = $errors.Add("Missing file for ${Label}: $Path")
    return ''
  }
  return [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path)
}
function Show-FileOrEmpty([string]$Ref, [string]$Path, [string]$Label) {
  $oldPreference = $ErrorActionPreference
  $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
  $text = & git show "${Ref}:$Path" 2>&1 | Out-String
  $code = $LASTEXITCODE
  $ErrorActionPreference = $oldPreference
  if ($code -ne 0) {
    $script:failed = $true
    $null = $errors.Add("git show failed for ${Label}: ${Ref}:$Path (exit $code) $text")
    return ''
  }
  return $text
}
function Write-DiffFile([string]$BaseOut, [string]$CurrentOut, [string]$DiffOut) {
  $oldPreference = $ErrorActionPreference
  $ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
  $diffText = & git diff --no-index --no-color -- $BaseOut $CurrentOut 2>&1 | Out-String
  $code = $LASTEXITCODE
  $ErrorActionPreference = $oldPreference
  $diffText | Out-File -FilePath $DiffOut -Encoding utf8
  if (($code -ne 0) -and ($code -ne 1)) {
    $script:failed = $true
    $null = $errors.Add("git diff --no-index failed for ${BaseOut} vs ${CurrentOut} with exit $code")
  }
}
function Compare-NormalizedText([string]$Name, [string]$BaseText, [string]$CurrentText) {
  $baseNormalized = Normalize-RelocationText $BaseText
  $currentNormalized = Normalize-RelocationText $CurrentText
  $baseOut = Join-Path $out "$Name.baseline.normalized.txt"
  $currentOut = Join-Path $out "$Name.current.normalized.txt"
  $diffOut = Join-Path $out "$Name.normalized.diff.txt"
  $baseNormalized | Out-File -FilePath $baseOut -Encoding utf8
  $currentNormalized | Out-File -FilePath $currentOut -Encoding utf8
  if ($baseNormalized -eq $currentNormalized) {
    "No normalized diff." | Out-File -FilePath $diffOut -Encoding utf8
    return $true
  }
  Write-DiffFile $baseOut $currentOut $diffOut
  return $false
}
$baselineInventoryJson = Join-Path $out 'baseline_generated_workflow_inventory.json'
$baselineInventoryMd = Join-Path $out 'baseline_generated_workflow_inventory.md'
$currentInventoryJson = Join-Path $out 'current_generated_workflow_inventory.json'
$currentInventoryMd = Join-Path $out 'current_generated_workflow_inventory.md'
$worktreeCode = Run-Step 'create_baseline_worktree' "git worktree add --detach `"$baselineWorktree`" $baseline"
if ($worktreeCode -eq 0) {
  Run-Step 'generate_baseline_inventory' "python project_sources/github_actions/tools/build_workflow_inventory.py --json-output `"$baselineInventoryJson`" --markdown-output `"$baselineInventoryMd`"" $baselineWorktree
} else {
  $null = $errors.Add("Baseline worktree was not created; baseline inventory generation skipped.")
}
Run-Step 'generate_current_inventory' "python .github/github_actions/tools/build_workflow_inventory.py --json-output `"$currentInventoryJson`" --markdown-output `"$currentInventoryMd`"" $repo
$baselineInventoryJsonText = Read-TextFile $baselineInventoryJson 'baseline generated workflow inventory JSON'
$currentInventoryJsonText = Read-TextFile $currentInventoryJson 'current generated workflow inventory JSON'
$baselineInventoryMdText = Read-TextFile $baselineInventoryMd 'baseline generated workflow inventory Markdown'
$currentInventoryMdText = Read-TextFile $currentInventoryMd 'current generated workflow inventory Markdown'
$baselineContractText = Show-FileOrEmpty $baseline 'project_sources/github_actions/workflow_modularization_contracts.json' 'baseline modularization contracts'
$currentContractText = Show-FileOrEmpty $current '.github/github_actions/workflow_modularization_contracts.json' 'current modularization contracts'
$inventoryJsonParity = Compare-NormalizedText 'workflow_inventory_json_generated' $baselineInventoryJsonText $currentInventoryJsonText
$inventoryMarkdownParity = Compare-NormalizedText 'workflow_inventory_markdown_generated' $baselineInventoryMdText $currentInventoryMdText
$contractParity = Compare-NormalizedText 'workflow_modularization_contracts_json' $baselineContractText $currentContractText
git diff --name-status $baseline $current -- .github/workflows .github/actions .github/github_actions project_sources/github_actions chatgpt_staging .github/chatgpt_staging ops .github/ops operator_tools .github/operator_tools tools .github/scripts scripts prompts schemas .github/dcoir_review | Out-File -FilePath (Join-Path $out 'baseline-to-current-name-status.txt') -Encoding utf8
git ls-tree -r --name-only $baseline .github/workflows .github/actions project_sources/github_actions chatgpt_staging ops operator_tools tools scripts prompts schemas | Out-File -FilePath (Join-Path $out 'baseline-workflow-surfaces.txt') -Encoding utf8
git ls-tree -r --name-only $current .github/workflows .github/actions .github/github_actions .github/chatgpt_staging .github/ops .github/operator_tools .github/scripts .github/dcoir_review tools scripts prompts schemas | Out-File -FilePath (Join-Path $out 'current-workflow-surfaces.txt') -Encoding utf8
Run-Step 'check_workflow_action_versions' 'python .github/github_actions/tools/check_workflow_action_versions.py'
Run-Step 'check_workflow_consistency_drift' 'python .github/github_actions/tools/check_workflow_consistency_drift.py'
Run-Step 'build_workflow_inventory_check' 'python .github/github_actions/tools/build_workflow_inventory.py --check'
Run-Step 'check_workflow_modularization_contracts' 'python .github/github_actions/tools/check_workflow_modularization_contracts.py'
Run-Step 'audit_reusable_contracts' 'python .github/github_actions/tools/audit_reusable_contracts.py'
$token = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('DCOIR_GITHUB_FG_TOKEN','Machine')
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($token)) { $token = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('DCOIR_GITHUB_CL_TOKEN','Machine') }
if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($token)) { $env:GH_TOKEN = $token }
Run-Step 'latest_workflow_maintenance_audit_runs' 'gh run list --workflow workflow-maintenance-audit.yml --branch main --limit 5 --json databaseId,workflowName,event,status,conclusion,headSha,createdAt,updatedAt,url' $repo $true
Run-Step 'latest_scheduled_health_check_runs' 'gh run list --workflow scheduled-health-check.yml --branch main --limit 5 --json databaseId,workflowName,event,status,conclusion,headSha,createdAt,updatedAt,url' $repo $true
$summary = [ordered]@{
  request_id = 'exec-20260713-issue380-regression-002'
  issue = 380
  baseline_ref = $baseline
  request_head_sha = $requestHead
  evaluated_current_ref = $current
  baseline_inventory_generation_attempted = ($worktreeCode -eq 0)
  normalized_inventory_json_generated_parity = $inventoryJsonParity
  normalized_inventory_markdown_generated_parity = $inventoryMarkdownParity
  normalized_contract_parity = $contractParity
  command_results = @($results)
  errors = @($errors)
}
$summary | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 50 | Out-File -FilePath (Join-Path $out 'issue380-regression-summary.json') -Encoding utf8
@(
  '# Issue #380 workflow regression evidence',
  '',
  "- baseline_ref: $baseline",
  "- request_head_sha: $requestHead",
  "- evaluated_current_ref: $current",
  "- normalized_inventory_json_generated_parity: $inventoryJsonParity",
  "- normalized_inventory_markdown_generated_parity: $inventoryMarkdownParity",
  "- normalized_contract_parity: $contractParity",
  '',
  '## Command results'
) | Out-File -FilePath (Join-Path $out 'issue380-regression-summary.md') -Encoding utf8
foreach ($result in $results) { "- $($result.name): exit $($result.exit_code) optional=$($result.optional) -> $($result.log)" | Out-File -FilePath (Join-Path $out 'issue380-regression-summary.md') -Encoding utf8 -Append }
if ($errors.Count -gt 0) {
  '' | Out-File -FilePath (Join-Path $out 'issue380-regression-summary.md') -Encoding utf8 -Append
  '## Errors' | Out-File -FilePath (Join-Path $out 'issue380-regression-summary.md') -Encoding utf8 -Append
  foreach ($item in $errors) { "- $item" | Out-File -FilePath (Join-Path $out 'issue380-regression-summary.md') -Encoding utf8 -Append }
}
if ((-not $inventoryJsonParity) -or (-not $inventoryMarkdownParity) -or (-not $contractParity) -or $failed) { exit 1 }
exit 0
